title: Client and Inference
summary: Provides unified interfaces for interacting with diverse language models, multimodal models, and image generation services. Abstracts API differences across providers to enable seamless model inference and token management.

nodes.label: Accept inference requests
nodes.title: Request intake
nodes.description: Receives and normalizes inference requests from benchmark runners and adapters, handling prompt formatting and parameter validation.

nodes.label: Route to appropriate model client
nodes.title: Model routing
nodes.description: Dispatches requests to the correct client implementation based on model identifier and type (language, vision, audio, image generation).

nodes.label: Language model clients
nodes.title: Language models
nodes.description: Implements clients for text-based models including OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Together, and other providers with unified completion interface.

nodes.label: Multimodal model clients
nodes.title: Multimodal models
nodes.description: Handles vision-language and audio-language models including IDEFICS, Qwen VLM, and Llama Omni for cross-modal inference tasks.

nodes.label: Image generation clients
nodes.title: Image generation
nodes.description: Manages text-to-image models like DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, and CogView2 with unified generation and quality assessment.

nodes.label: Count and estimate tokens
nodes.title: Token management
nodes.description: Tracks token usage across requests, estimates costs, and enforces context window limits for each model provider.

nodes.label: Parse and normalize responses
nodes.title: Response processing
nodes.description: Converts provider-specific response formats into standardized completion objects with metadata and error handling.

nodes.label: Return inference results
nodes.title: Result return
nodes.description: Delivers processed completions back to benchmark runners with token counts, latency, and provider-specific metadata.

groups.label: Model Clients
groups.title: Model client implementations
groups.description: Specialized client implementations for different model types and providers, each handling provider-specific APIs and protocols.

groups.label: Inference Pipeline
groups.title: End-to-end inference flow
groups.description: Main request-response pipeline from intake through routing, model execution, and result delivery.

groups.label: Support Services
groups.title: Cross-cutting services
groups.description: Shared utilities for token counting, cost estimation, and response normalization across all model types.
